title: Restriction of a mapping-simplex presentation to subcomplexes with selected markings
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and degreewise pullbacks from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], cartesian fibrations and cartesian edges from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], categorical equivalences from [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure], the marked mapping simplex $M^m(A)$ of a chain from [lem-coef-cartesian-mapping-simplex-presentation], and marked simplicial sets and weak equivalences in the marked model structure over a point from [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model]. Let $n\geq0$, let $Y\to\Delta^n$ be a cartesian fibration with $Y$ small, let $A_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow A_n$ be a chain of small simplicial sets, and let $q:M^m(A)\to Y$ be a simplicial map over $\Delta^n$ which carries every edge $(\alpha,a)$ of $M^m(A)$ with $a$ degenerate to a cartesian edge of $Y\to\Delta^n$, and whose maps $A_i\to Y_i=Y\times_{\Delta^n}\{i\}$ on vertex fibres are categorical equivalences. Let $K\subseteq\Delta^n$ be a simplicial subset and $E$ a set of edges of $K$ containing its degenerate edges. Put $M_K=M^m(A)\times_{\Delta^n}K$ and $Y_K=Y\times_{\Delta^n}K$. Mark in $M_K$ the edges $(\alpha,a)$ with $\alpha\in E$ and $a$ degenerate, and mark in $Y_K$ the cartesian edges of $Y\to\Delta^n$ lying over edges in $E$. Then $q$ restricts to a marking-preserving map $q_{K,E}:M_K\to Y_K$, and $q_{K,E}$ is a weak equivalence in the marked model structure over a point. For $K'\subseteq K$ and $E'\subseteq E$ with $E'$ a set of edges of $K'$ as above, $q_{K',E'}$ is the restriction of $q_{K,E}$ along the marked inclusions $M_{K'}\subseteq M_K$ and $Y_{K'}\subseteq Y_K$. The assertions include $n=0$, empty $K$ and empty fibres.

source.place: Restriction consequence of the mapping-simplex comparison: HTT Section 3.2.2, Proposition 3.2.2.7 and Proposition 3.2.2.14, as used for horns in the proof of Proposition 3.2.2.12. The mapping simplex and the presentation itself are the existing node lem-coef-cartesian-mapping-simplex-presentation; the restriction to simplicial subsets and the selected marking (only transports above E inverted; equivalences in fibres are inverted by every functor) are an agent formulation. Read online, not archived in literature/; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical result.
